about: The feature cards of the project website, in this order (the first is the large one), read by its updater at the latest release tag. image: site/img/<image>-960.webp (and -1920.webp), made from screenshots/<image>.png by tools/site_images.py --write. title and alt are plain text; text may use `code` and **bold**; more is the line under the cards with one [link text]. Checked by tools/site_figures.py --check.

features.title: The 16:9 edit and its 9:16 short in one project
features.text: Auto reframe follows the subject and keeps a game's kill feed readable. Word captions come from the speech, and the export presets for YouTube Shorts, Reels and TikTok check length and loudness.
features.alt: A 9:16 short next to the 16:9 edit: reframed picture with karaoke captions

features.title: Keys, masks and tracking
features.text: Green screen, text behind a person or a pillar, a blurred face that follows. Trackers notice when they lose a point and fade out or hold. As a node graph or as a simple layer stack, with ready recipes, and shapes and drawing right on the video.
features.alt: The Comp page: a green screen key as a node graph with a title behind the presenter

features.title: Wheels, curves, qualifier and scopes
features.text: Curves over the histogram, an HSL qualifier for one color range, windows, LUTs and a stills gallery to compare grades. HDR video from phones is turned into normal SDR automatically, and H.265 and AV1 export in 10 bit.
features.alt: The Color page: the curves palette with an S curve over the histogram, the RGB parade beside the viewer

features.title: A page for the sound
features.text: Large waveforms, a mixer strip per track with EQ and compressor, volume curves you draw or ride live. Clean a voice, duck the music or hit a loudness target in one click, and mix in stereo, 5.1 or 7.1.
features.alt: The Studio page: audio tracks with large waveforms, a drawn level curve on the music and a mixer column with the loudness readout

features.title: Hours of recordings, synced by their sound
features.text: Line up several PCs or cameras automatically and cut between up to 16 angles. Click an angle or press 1 to 9.
features.alt: Multicam view with nine angles of one event

features.title: Real 3D text, counters, captions
features.text: Extruded and beveled letters with light, title looks with gradients and glow, and karaoke captions where the spoken word lights up.
features.alt: A golden 3D title with bevel, turned in space

features.title: One template, many videos
features.text: Mark the clips, texts, song and logo of an edit as placeholders. Then drop new clips onto it, or fill it from a table: one finished video per row, with your brand kit's logo, colors and fonts.
features.alt: File, New from Template: the built-in templates as tiles with preview, format, length and fields

features.title: Presets, a render queue and a check before export
features.text: Presets for YouTube, Shorts, Reels and TikTok. Before rendering, one click finds what often goes wrong: a gap between two clips, missing files, clipping, loudness off the target, text a phone app covers.
features.alt: The Deliver page: render settings and the render queue

more.text: Also guided tours on a practice project, ripple, roll, slip and slide trims, a brand kit, voice-over recording, offline text to speech, key sets from Premiere Pro and Final Cut Pro, a preview on a second monitor, and FCP7 XML, OpenTimelineIO and EDL to move a cut to or from other editors.
